title: JESD204C-style 64b/66b link layer: scrambling, sync header stream (CRC-12, command channel), multiblock and extended multiblock alignment

fields.desc: command sent in each multiblock (sampled as the multiblock starts: IRQ TX_MB)

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Transmit block payload (TX0 = bits 31:0, TX1 = bits 63:32; writing TX1 commits it); one block goes out every 66 PCLK, a block without data is sent as zeros (TX_UNDERRUN)

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Received block (RX0 = bits 31:0, RX1 = bits 63:32, RX2 = start flags; reading RX2 frees it); one arrives every 66 PCLK while emb_lock

fdesc.rx_emb_start: first block of an extended multiblock

regs.name: MB
regs.desc: Multiblock received (with emb_lock); reading MB frees it

fdesc.rx_crc_err: its CRC field did not match the previous multiblock

irqs.name: TX_UNDERRUN
irqs.desc: a block went out as zeros: TX was empty

irqs.name: ERR_SH
irqs.desc: an invalid sync header while locked

irqs.name: ERR_EMB
irqs.desc: a multiblock or extended multiblock alignment error

notes: tx_p and rx_p are the serial lane pins (one bit per PCLK); they pass through unchanged.
